name: as.yearqtr
title: An Index Class for Quarterly Data

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric, Date, POSIXt, character, yearmon, or yearqtr value.

origin.details: The numeric method snaps with yearqtr. With format omitted, a lower-case q selects %Y q%q, an upper-case Q selects %Y Q%q, and otherwise the format is %Y-%q. %q is read as a month number and kept only when that month index is 0 through 3, so 1 is quarter 1 and 4 is quarter 4. Date and POSIXt go through as.yearmon first.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearqtr.
origin.example:
x <- as.yearqtr(c("2001 Q2", "2001 Q1", "2001 Q4"))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(format(as.yearqtr("2001 q2")), format(as.yearqtr("2001-2")), sep = " "), "\n", sep = "")

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number, string, date, datetime, Yearmon, or Yearqtr.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: Format for character input. None or an empty string picks %Y q%q, %Y Q%q, or %Y-%q.

translation.details: A quarter digit is parsed as a month and accepted only when the zero-based month is 0, 1, 2, or 3. "2001 Q2", "2001 q2", and "2001-2" are all 2001.25. A Date is converted with as_yearmon and then snapped to a quarter. chron, timeDate, mondate, and tis classes raise TypeError.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearqtr import as_yearqtr, format_yearqtr
x = as_yearqtr(["2001 Q2", "2001 Q1", "2001 Q4"])
print(" ".join(format(v, ".17g") for v in x.value))
print(format_yearqtr(as_yearqtr("2001 q2"))[0], format_yearqtr(as_yearqtr("2001-2"))[0])
